sortedNodes(graph)

 

i Returns a sorted list of the nodes in the graph graph

The iterator graph.Nodes is based on a hash table and may give different orders on different calls. This functions instead gives a list that has the same order on every call.

Parameters:
  • graph (IGraph) - The graph containing the nodes.
Returns: [INode]
Sorted list of the nodes in the graph (sorted by name).
Decorators:

nodeBoundaryIter(area)

 

Make an iterator that returns nodes on the boundary of the area. Each of the returned nodes is either a node for which the corresponding nodeIndex is not connected to any edge in area, or the node of which the degree is at most 1.

Parameters:
  • area (IGraph) - the area where all boundary nodes are iterated.
Returns: Iterable(INode)
An interator returning the boundary nodes of area.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

containsBentSwitchLeg(nodeIndex)

 

Check if nodeIndex contains a bent switch leg.

In more detail, check if the node contains a switch which has its bent switch leg pointing in the same direction as the index.

Parameters:
  • nodeIndex (NodeIndex) - The node index we are examining.
Returns: bool
True iff nodeIndex contains a bent switch leg.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

containsStraightSwitchLeg(nodeIndex)

 

Check if nodeIndex contains a straight switch leg.

In more detail, check if the node contains a switch which has its straight switch leg pointing in the same direction as the index (note that this definition means that both containsBentSwitchLeg(nodeIndex) and containsStraightSwitchLeg(nodeIndex) can be simultaneously false.

Parameters:
  • nodeIndex (NodeIndex) - The node index we are examining.
Returns: bool
True iff nodeIndex contains a straight switch leg.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc

createPath(subtype, name, start_node, edges, start_obj=None, end_obj=None)

 

Convenience function to create a path.

The path created by this function is given two attributes, namely 'start_obj' and 'end_obj' of which the values are provided by the arguements start_obj and end_obj.

Parameters:
  • subtype (str) - The usertype of the path to be created.
  • name (str) - The name of the path to be created.
  • start_node (INode) - The node that the path starts.
  • edges (Iterable(IEdge)) - The collection of edges included in the path to be created.
  • start_obj (IRailyardComponent|None) - The start object of the path to be created.
  • end_obj (IRailyardComponent|None) - the end object of the path to be created.
Returns: IPath
The path object that is created.
Decorators:
  • @typedoc
